component.name: clpeak
component.summary: Measure peak compute, bandwidth and latency of GPUs and CPUs

description.p: clpeak (compute latency peak) measures the peak compute throughput, memory bandwidth and latency that a machine's GPUs and CPUs actually reach. It uses small, tight kernels alongside each vendor's own tuned libraries, and runs the same tests through every API that exposes a device, so the results line up side by side.
It has two front-ends over the same benchmark engine: a desktop app for picking devices and tests and watching results come in, and a command-line tool for scripted runs.
This Flatpak enables the backends that work inside the sandbox:

ul.li: Vulkan — compute, bandwidth, cooperative-matrix (tensor) and latency
OpenCL — when the host exposes an ICD the sandbox can see
Native CPU — SIMD compute, cache/DRAM bandwidth and memory latency

description.p: Benchmarks include device, local and image memory bandwidth, CPU cache and DRAM bandwidth, single, half, double and mixed precision compute, integer and dot-product throughput, cooperative-matrix operations, and kernel launch and memory latency. Runs are saved as JSON and can be compared against a saved run.

The CUDA, ROCm and oneAPI backends, and the ONNX Runtime and LiteRT backends that reach NPUs, are not available in this Flatpak because they need vendor toolkits, drivers or runtimes that cannot be shipped through Flathub; use the upstream binary releases for those.
